tagline: Architectural Cuts • Low-Fi Atmosphere • Northbridge Creative Precinct
businessDescription: An independent studio space at the intersection of street culture, modern hair architecture, and coffee conversation. District 9 abandons assembly-line barbering in favour of bespoke consultations, tailored taper fades, textured scissor work, and honest hospitality in Northbridge.

seo.title: District 9 Barber Co. | Modern Hair Architecture | Northbridge Perth
seo.description: Independent barber studio in Northbridge, Perth. Taper fades, textured shear work, scalp treatments, and bespoke styling.

services.name: The Studio Cut & Consult
services.description: Comprehensive hair consultation, precision scissors and shear blend, organic wash, and clay finish.

services.name: Zero & Architectural Fade
services.description: Drop fade, burst fade, or taper fade engineered to personal crown patterns and lifestyle maintenance.

services.name: Beard Architecture & Steam
services.description: Scissor de-bulking, cheek line definition, warm cedarwood oil massage, and razor line detailing.

services.name: Full Overhaul: Cut + Beard
services.description: The complete studio transformation: architectural cut, custom beard sculpt, and cold brew refreshment.

services.name: Scalp Detox & Exfoliation
services.description: Tea tree purifying scalp scrub, head massage, and invigorating cold rinse for active lifestyles.

packages.name: The Northbridge Session
packages.description: Designed for the urban resident: complete cut, beard detailing, and botanic hair wash.

packages.name: The Editorial Treatment
packages.description: Deep craft session including scalp clarifying, bespoke scissor sculpting, straight razor line, and styling tutorial.

team.name: Zane Kaluza
team.bio: Editorial stylist with training in Melbourne and London; championing natural movement and modern silhouettes.

team.name: Toby Chen
team.bio: Known across Perth for razor-clean skin fades, textured crop styling, and low tapers.

team.name: Liam Murphy
team.bio: Specialist in longer shears, surfer mullets, and natural textured scissor cuts.

reviews.name: Harrison V.
reviews.review: Easily the coolest and most attentive barbershop in Northbridge. Zane spent 10 minutes actually discussing what would work with my hair texture before cutting. 10/10.

reviews.name: Callum Wright
reviews.review: No pretension, just genuine craft. Toby's fades are surgical. The studio playlist and design are great bonuses.

reviews.name: Sean Davies
reviews.review: Found my regular spot after moving to Perth from Sydney. Clean, contemporary, and relaxed.
